description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Malzahar''' opens two portals to the void centered at the target location, granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area in between. After 0.4 seconds, enemies between the portals are dealt magic damage and [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Silence|An icon representing the keyword Silence]] [[:Silence|silenced]] for a duration.
